record_scope_reconstruction: Ordinary road passengers at Boten–Mohan. The January 2023 relaxation remained limited for tourists; railway service terminating at Boten is expressly distinct.

source_checks.finding: Lao national news quotes checkpoint immigration chief on Jan 8–11 two-way movement, while tourist visas were still not accepted for China.
RFA identifies Boten road gate movements and states international through-rail service was still under discussion.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Ordinary road passengers at Boten–Mohan. The January 2023 relaxation remained limited for tourists; railway service terminating at Boten is expressly distinct.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: EA028-D1: RFA documented restriction to essential cargo and business travellers at Boten by 6 March 2020; that is an observation bound, not the exact first day. Approved business and essential movement existed before 2023, including fast-track arrangements from November 2020. Laos reopened May 9, 2022; Chinese tourist-visa entry remained excluded after January 8, 2023. This phase does not assert an uninterrupted ban on all business travellers or all two-way movement. Freight and the new April 2023 railway service are excluded.
